name: Delicious Spiced Fried Chicken
desc: Fried chicken wrapped in a crispy green skin. Take a bite while it's hot, and the spicy flavor will awaken your taste buds as the bountiful juices burst forth between your teeth, refreshing your spirit... In this state, you feel as if you could learn just about anything!

value.text: Restores 35% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 930 HP every 5s for 30s.
